local_review.finding_body: The 5.8.0 test project forced ZooKeeper from Curator 5.8.0's resolved 3.9.2 dependency to 3.5.10 solely to exercise legacy Compatibility branches. This changed the tested runtime graph and added unrelated build setup rather than adapting the test to the target version, violating the no-scope-creep requirement in FS-test-contract.2.9.
local_review.finding_title: Test forces an unrelated transitive dependency version
local_review.fix_note: Removed the ZooKeeper 3.5.10 resolution override and updated CompatibilityTest to assert Curator 5.8.0 behavior with its declared ZooKeeper dependency. Forge finalization regenerated stats for the corrected runtime graph; covered dynamic-access calls remained at 115 and every required lane passed.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the complete contribution diff and local gate evidence under the fixes-java-run-fail rules. The final tree is limited to org.apache.curator:curator-client:5.8.0, uses only reachability-metadata.json, preserves meaningful RetryLoop behavior without swallowed failures or Native Image skips, and has a valid index. The repair coverage gate passes overall (109/123, 88.62% to 115/122, 94.26%), for reflection (107/119, 89.92% to 113/118, 95.76%), and for resources (2/4, 50% to 2/4, 50%). The exact Forge finalization command completed without further publishable changes after running all three test lanes, metadata splitting and validation, style checks, generated-test checks, and refreshed statistics. Approved after the contribution-local repair.
